title: Papertiger local planner contracts
description: Every field is provider-local. Stored prose, locators, identities and history require editorial review before external publication. This schema validates structure, not authority integrity, evidence bytes, or producer semantics.
$comment: Current-schema reads are versioned. Dump defaults support minimal current-format imports. Model attribution is caller-reported, not authenticated.

handle.description: Kind letter and task number, e.g. F-924; derived from kind and seq, never stored.

priority.description: Scheduling level within readiness order: now, next (default) or later.

model_source.description: How the model was reported: flag (the author's own report), environment (configured at launch) or runtime (a transition the tool performed itself); null on events recorded before authorship was required.

harness.description: Harness the writing session ran in, when one was detected.

model_source.description: How the model was reported: flag (the author's own report), environment (configured at launch) or runtime (a transition the tool performed itself); null on events recorded before authorship was required.

harness.description: Harness the writing session ran in, when one was detected.

session.description: Session that wrote the event, when known.

mise_projection.description: Producer-owned Mise projection, validated by the dedicated Mise contract.

ancestry.description: Ancestor handles from the root down to the direct parent; empty for a root task.

open_by_kind.description: Proposed and in-progress tasks per kind, in kind order; kinds with no open task are omitted.

priority.description: Scheduling level within readiness order: now, next (default) or later.

pickup.description: Advisory last pickup, never an exclusive claim. Its owner process, when recorded, only lets a reader on the same host prove the owner ended. Null means no current pickup context.

owner.description: The harness process that picked the task up, identified by host, PID and birth time; absent when the harness names no process.

focus.description: Concise selection with task and plan summaries, advisory pickup and independent blockers. Use show for full task context.

closed_child_count.description: Children of a parent whose children are all closed, so closing the parent is the remaining work; 0 for leaf tasks.

ancestry.description: Ancestor handles from the root down to the direct parent; empty for a root task.

unreviewed_dependencies.description: Done dependencies whose results still need review; results recorded before authorship are not listed.

task_outline.description: Input to `papertiger decompose <parent> --outline-file <path|->`: the parent's new child tasks. A string dependency names a sibling key; an integer names an existing task in the parent's plan. Keys wire dependencies only and are never stored. The papertiger.mutation.v2 receipt lists one task create event per child, in outline order, before any dependency or status event. The document is at most 1048576 bytes and may not repeat a key within any object.

why.description: Rationale recorded for every child that states no why of its own, including when --start-ready starts it.

title.description: Nonblank, at most 160 characters after trimming leading and trailing whitespace. Titles compare trimmed and case-insensitive with the other children and the parent's live children.

tags.description: Each tag nonblank, at most 64 characters after trimming, and listed once after trimming.

priority.description: Scheduling level within readiness order: now, next (default) or later.

deps.description: Each dependency once; an integral number such as 3.0 names task 3.

task_kind.description: Kind of outcome; work is the legacy kind of tasks recorded before typed kinds.

claim_review.description: Review state of one claim, derived from the event log.

legacy.description: Recorded before 1.0 required authorship; same-agent review of it cannot be detected.

task_review.description: Review state of a task's filing and, once done, its result.

model_report.description: Claim outcomes per normalized authoring model; counts only, ranking nothing. Claims recorded before authorship group under 'unknown'.

owner_state.description: Whether a pickup's owner still runs, observed now: running, ended (provably, on its host), or unknown; null without a pickup. Age is never proof.

brief.description: One task and its whole subtree for resuming work: bounded sections, each with an omitted count.

review.description: Review of the result; null when its completion is not in history.
